code.seed_basis: Repository-owned synthetic fixtures plus newly authored minimal synthetic variants; no third-party benchmark redistribution required.
code.oracle: Executable criteria-specific tests or deterministic inspection rules with gold labels frozen before gate execution.

document_plan.seed_basis: Newly authored synthetic documents and plans stored in-repository with explicit acceptance criteria and fault manifests.
document_plan.oracle: Deterministic structural/link/schema checks plus pre-adjudicated semantic gold labels; semantic labels are not disclosed to gate variants.

repeat_design.pairing: Each eligible case is evaluated by every compatible variant; stochastic variants repeat under recorded seeds/order.

secondary_metrics: coverage or mutation score where applicable
contamination_controls: Freeze case artifacts, criteria, gold labels, and digests before runs.
Withhold seeded-fault labels and scorer logic from gate variants.
Separate test generation from adjudication where possible.
Randomize case and variant order and retain seeds.
Use synthetic or repository-owned cases and record any pre-existing public exposure.
Keep training-data independence as unknown; do not claim it from synthetic construction alone.
precision_rationale: The proposed 60-case paired design supports descriptive comparison and per-fault-class error intervals but is not represented as powered for small between-variant differences. Report binomial uncertainty and paired differences; treat sparse strata as exploratory.
calibration_stop_condition: met: at least one feasible, legally usable benchmark design is identified for both code and document/plan artifacts
open_decisions_for_human_protocol_gate: Approve creation of the 60-case synthetic corpus during full execution.
Approve the minimum number of cases per fault family after pilot case construction.
Approve whether security-relevant cases require a separate higher-risk sandbox tier.
